rationale: The Court is most likely to affirm on a narrow, as-applied due-process theory: ATCA’s jurisdictional triggers do not amount to knowing, voluntary consent or a sufficiently claim-linked U.S. nexus, so Congress cannot "deem" submission on this record. Expect separate writings to press the unresolved Fifth Amendment/original-meaning question (Thomas/Barrett) and to emphasize finality/retroactivity and administrability limits (Jackson/Kavanaugh).
